description: We send kids to school for reading, math, and the occasional history class snooze. But what if the students are made of circuits and steel? In Hangzhou, a school just welcomed humanoid robots as its newest pupils. As machines get smarter, building them is only half the battle. They might need a curriculum, too. On the show: Steve, Yushan & Ding Heng
classificationReason: 核心内容是杭州学校接收人形机器人作为学生，以及机器人教育问题。
qualityReason: 为聚焦事件的新闻讨论，篇幅和技术深度有限。
